Visitor removes all line breaks

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
visitor = Class.new do
  def visit_line_break(*args)
    'skip'
  end
end.new
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<p>Address Line 1<br>Address Line 2<br>Address Line 3</p>', visitor)
puts result.inspect
```
